critic raised a concrete objection: The proposed FY2026Q2 comparable sales of 1.00023% is effectively just last year’s Q2 figure carried forward. Home Depot reported total-company comps of 1.0% in FY2025Q2 (your evidence), and your 90.1%/9.9% weighted blend of 1.13333 and −0.216667 lands at ~1.00%, mirroring that prior-year number. Comparable sales are a year-over-year rate for the current quarter (FY2026Q2 vs FY2025Q2); they should not mechanically equal the prior-year Q2 comp. This indicates a wrong-period carry-forward rather than a true FY2026Q2 estimate.
